description: Get 7-day weather forecast for a US location by latitude/longitude. Returns day and night periods with temperature (°F), precipitation chance, wind speed/direction, and detailed forecast text. Powered by NOAA National Weather Service (api.weather.gov). US contiguous only.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (US contiguous only: 24–50)

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (US contiguous only: −125 to −66)
